name: D-ID V4 Expressive Visual Agents
desc: Real-time conversational avatars with expression driven by emotion
desc_zh: 表情跟着情绪走的实时对话数字人
solves: Scripted avatar video plays back flat. These agents hold a live conversation and perform the emotion the text carries.
solves_zh: 按脚本拍的数字人视频表情是平的。这类 Agent 能实时对话，并按文字里的情绪去演。
best_for: You need a support avatar that answers live instead of replaying a clip.
best_for_zh: 要一个能实时回答的客服数字人，而不是循环播放一段录像。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://www.d-id.com/blog/ (D-ID's blog, 'Introducing V4 Expressive Visual A）。 Outside the 2026-05-07 → 2026-11-24 window but absent from the ledger, which holds only the 2017 'D-ID' photo-to-video entry. Delivered as real-time sessions over the D-ID Client SDK (WebRTC), hence form 'api'. V4 Expressive Avatars (the offline avatar model, announced 2026-02-03) is a different, model-level release and is not filed. Presentation Mode (2026-10-15) runs on these agents. 首次公开日期来源：https://www.d-id.com/blog/v4-expressive-visual-agents/
